TLS backend: OpenSSL 3.5.9 (official upstream backend).
External private key path: OpenVPN 3 Core upstream OpenSSL XKey provider.
ECDSA contract: XKey Sign supplies a digest with an empty hash name; XKey DigestSign supplies the message and SHA-256/384/512. Android Keystore performs the ECDSA signature without exporting the P-256 key.
Application cryptographic patches: none.
